copyBetting.title: Copy-betting
copyBetting.cardDescription: Independent of the kill switch — gates whether a bet detected in the master browser actually gets replicated to sub-accounts.
copyBetting.armDescription: From now on, a bet placed in the master's browser will be replicated to every operational sub-account, using each account's own bet-sizing settings. Opening the master browser never arms this on its own.
copyBetting.disarmDescription: A bet placed in the master's browser will stop being replicated to sub-accounts — it'll still be detected and logged, just not copied. The master browser itself stays open either way.
copyBetting.notArmed: Not armed — detected bets are logged but never replicated.
copyBetting.scopeHint: The master browser stays open either way — this only controls whether a detected bet gets replicated.
copyBetting.bannerDescription: A bet placed in the master browser right now will be replicated to sub-accounts.

automationSettings.labelAutoHold: Put account on hold after (failed heartbeats in a row)
automationSettings.jitterSmallerThanInterval: Jitter must be smaller than the interval
automationSettings.savedDescription: Heartbeat timing applies from the next heartbeat.
automationSettings.title: Automation settings
automationSettings.description: System-wide: these apply to every account.
automationSettings.intervalDescription: Time between heartbeats for each account. Default 5000.
automationSettings.jitterDescription: Random offset so accounts don't beat in lockstep. Default 1500.
automationSettings.rangeHint: Each account sends a heartbeat every {{range}}. Changes apply from the next heartbeat.
automationSettings.thresholdDescription: Put account on hold after (failed heartbeats in a row). Stops a failing account from sending requests, so it doesn't look like unusual activity or hit rate limits. Resume it from the account page. 0 = never. Default 5.
automationSettings.maxConcurrentBetsDescription: How many open bets one account may have at once.
automationSettings.dailyLossLimitDescription: All accounts combined, per day. Leave empty for no limit.
automationSettings.betPlacementNotBuilt: Bet placement isn't built yet. These limits are saved now and enforced once it is.
